owner.name: Tory
owner.bio: Im a scripter or not, i like modifying scripts, and research networkownership abuse.

scripts.title: Universal UI Library
scripts.description: A lightweight, modern UI library for Roblox scripts. Draggable windows, themes and a smooth tween animation system — runs on every executor.

scripts.title: Network Ownership Lab
scripts.description: A research playground for networkownership abuse: claim ownership, observe transfer logic and test the limits of the physics replication system.

scripts.title: Anti-AFK
scripts.description: Simple and reliable anti-AFK that simulates input at configurable intervals. Tiny, no dependencies, paste & go.

scripts.title: Speed Farm Hub
scripts.description: A farming hub with teleport waypoints, auto-click toggles and per-game config presets. Built on top of my UI library.

scripts.title: Instance Spawner
scripts.description: A GUI tool for spawning, cloning and inspecting Instances at runtime. Great for testing and script debugging.
